name: Mississippi Comic Con
blurb: A three-day pop-culture and comics convention at the Mississippi Trade Mart in Jackson with celebrity and creator guests.

editions.evidence: Eventeny listing: 'Jun 25, 2027 3:00 PM - Jun 27, 2027 5:00 PM', Trade Mart and Arena, 1200 Mississippi St, Jackson, MS; matches venue hours on official site (Fri 3-8pm, Sat 10-6, Sun 11-5)

notes: The official homepage title is stale and still shows 'June 26-28, 2026' (that edition already passed before the 2026-10-05 research window); Eventeny confirms the next edition is June 25-27, 2027. Guests page shows 4 placeholder guest photos with no names and boilerplate 'list of guests scheduled to appear... will be updated' text — treated as not-yet-announced rather than unreadable.
